findings.title: Buffer overflow in CAN frame parser via strcpy
findings.evidence: strcpy(local_buf, payload_str) where local_buf is 8 bytes
findings.suggested_fix: Replace strcpy with strncpy(local_buf, payload_str, sizeof(local_buf)-1)

findings.title: Null dereference after failed sensor allocation
findings.evidence: malloc() return used without NULL check
findings.suggested_fix: Add if (ptr == NULL) { return ERROR; } immediately after malloc

findings.title: fopen return value not checked in logger
findings.evidence: FILE* fp = fopen(path, "a"); fprintf(fp, ...) without NULL check
findings.suggested_fix: Add NULL check after fopen and return error code on failure

findings.title: 16-bit multiplication overflow in ADC conversion
findings.evidence: uint16_t result = raw_val * vref_mv / 4096 overflows for large raw_val
findings.suggested_fix: Use uint32_t intermediate: uint32_t temp = (uint32_t)raw_val * vref_mv / 4096
